reason: The two trial slots should measure int4-g128 as the quality-supported reference and vdown4-rest3-g128 as the memory-reduction hypothesis: it uses 3-bit base weights while protecting value/down projections and embedding/head at 4 bits. The evidence shows int4 quality at 1.0 but has no BF16 throughput reference or heldout results. No lower-memory recipe has demonstrated 0.95 quality, and the vdown recipe is unmeasured. I rank smaller-group 3-bit and broader-protection variants next as hypotheses; the measured mixed3-4 and int3 results fell below the quality target. Mixed2-4 has high reported throughput but quality 0.0, so it ranks last.
